'''Yaris''', referred to as '''"Old Yaris"''', was a retired [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. He was acquainted with a group of adventurers who he regarded as the children he never had.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
